description: Cursor paginator only checks timestamp > cursor_timestamp, dropping sibling records with identical timestamps.
spec_notes: CursorPaginator must apply secondary tie-breaker comparison (created_at > after_ts) or (created_at == after_ts and log_id > after_id).

tests.test_cursor_pagination.py:
from models import AuditLog
from database import AuditLogDB
from pagination import CursorPaginator


def test_pagination_distinct_timestamps():
    db = AuditLogDB()
    db.insert_batch([
        AuditLog("log_1", 100, "login"),
        AuditLog("log_2", 200, "edit"),
        AuditLog("log_3", 300, "logout"),
    ])
    p = CursorPaginator(db)
    page1 = p.fetch_page(None, limit=2)
    assert [r.log_id for r in page1.items] == ["log_1", "log_2"]
    assert page1.has_more is True
    assert page1.next_cursor is not None

    page2 = p.fetch_page(page1.next_cursor, limit=2)
    assert [r.log_id for r in page2.items] == ["log_3"]
    assert page2.has_more is False
    assert page2.next_cursor is None


def test_identical_timestamp_secondary_key_pagination():
    db = AuditLogDB()
    # 4 records sharing the EXACT same timestamp 1000
    db.insert_batch([
        AuditLog("a", 1000, "op_a"),
        AuditLog("b", 1000, "op_b"),
        AuditLog("c", 1000, "op_c"),
        AuditLog("d", 1000, "op_d"),
    ])
    p = CursorPaginator(db)
    # Page 1: limit 2 -> [a, b]
    p1 = p.fetch_page(None, limit=2)
    assert [r.log_id for r in p1.items] == ["a", "b"]
    assert p1.has_more is True

    # Page 2: with cursor from b -> MUST return [c, d], NOT empty list!
    p2 = p.fetch_page(p1.next_cursor, limit=2)
    assert [r.log_id for r in p2.items] == ["c", "d"]
    assert p2.has_more is False


def test_empty_db_page():
    db = AuditLogDB()
    p = CursorPaginator(db)
    page = p.fetch_page(None, limit=10)
    assert len(page.items) == 0
    assert page.has_more is False
    assert page.next_cursor is None


def test_single_item_fits_in_page():
    db = AuditLogDB()
    db.insert_batch([AuditLog("x", 50, "action")])
    p = CursorPaginator(db)
    page = p.fetch_page(None, limit=5)
    assert len(page.items) == 1
    assert page.has_more is False
    assert page.next_cursor is None


def test_cursor_roundtrip_codec():
    p = CursorPaginator(AuditLogDB())
    cur = p.encode_cursor(123456, "log_alpha")
    ts, lid = p.decode_cursor(cur)
    assert ts == 123456
    assert lid == "log_alpha"
